Class SpinnerElement

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.toolkit.element.StyledElement<SpinnerElement>
dev.tamboui.toolkit.elements.SpinnerElement
All Implemented Interfaces:
Styleable, Element
public final class SpinnerElement extends StyledElement<SpinnerElement>
An element that displays an animated spinner with an optional label.

The spinner cycles through frame characters on each render tick, creating a loading animation effect. 

// Simple spinner
spinner()

// Spinner with label
spinner("Loading...").cyan()

// Spinner with specific style
spinner(SpinnerStyle.LINE, "Processing...")

// Spinner with custom frames
spinner().frames("*", "+", "x", "+").label("Working")

// Spinner with custom frame set
spinner().frameSet(SpinnerFrameSet.of("⠋", "⠙", "⠹", "⠸")).label("Working")

CSS Properties

The spinner style and frames can be configured via CSS:

  • spinner-style - Predefined spinner style (e.g., dots, line, bouncing-bar, gauge)
  • spinner-frames - Custom animation frames as quoted strings (e.g., spinner-frames: "-" "\\" "|" "/")

Example CSS: 

.my-spinner {
    spinner-style: line;
    color: cyan;
}

.custom-spinner {
    spinner-frames: "⠋" "⠙" "⠹" "⠸" "⠼" "⠴" "⠦" "⠧";
}

Note: Programmatic styles set via spinnerStyle, frameSet(SpinnerFrameSet), or frames(String...) take precedence over CSS styles.

    • preferredSize

      public Size preferredSize(int availableWidth, int availableHeight, RenderContext context)
      Description copied from interface: Element
      Returns the preferred size of this element.

      The availableWidth/Height parameters allow elements to adapt their dimensions based on constraints. Use -1 for unconstrained.

      Common patterns:

      • Text elements: height depends on width (text wrapping)
      • Aspect-ratio elements: both dimensions interrelated
      • Fixed elements: ignore available dimensions

      Return value semantics:

      • Positive values = known size (use as constraint)
      • Zero = explicitly zero-sized (element should collapse)
      • Negative (-1) = unknown size (element should fill available space)
      Parameters:
      availableWidth - the available width in cells, or -1 if unconstrained
      availableHeight - the available height in cells, or -1 if unconstrained
      context - the render context for CSS resolution, may be null
      Returns:
      the preferred size
